description: REMOVES SCRATCHES & SWIRL MARKS Turtle Wax Rubbing Compound helps smooth out visible scratches, swirl marks, scuffs and paint transfer marks from car exterior surfaces, restoring a cleaner and more refined finish. RESTORES DULL & OXIDIZED PAINT Deep cleans and rejuvenates old, faded and oxidized paint, helping bring back the original colour, shine and vibrancy of your vehicle’s exterior. CONTROLLED SPOT APPLICATION Ideal for targeted application on affected areas such as scuffs, scratches, paint transfer and localized dull patches.
